title: H^m of a ball in an m-dimensional linear subspace (parent B10c)
statement: The m-dimensional Hausdorff measure of a ball in an m-dimensional subspace. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; a linear subspace H₀ ⊆ ℝ^P with dim H₀ = m (Module.finrank ℝ H₀ = m); ρ > 0. Conclusion: H^m(H₀ ∩ B_ρ(0)) = ω_m·ρ^m, i.e. μHE[m](H₀ ∩ ball 0 ρ) = unitBallVolume m · ofReal(ρ^m), where unitBallVolume m is the Lebesgue measure of the unit ball of ℝ^m.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (H₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ H₀ = m → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → μHE[m] ((H₀ : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball 0 ρ) = unitBallVolume m * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ m)
